_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- INTERFEROMETER mode: Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array (VLA)
_meta.companion: data/interf/vla.md (same content as Markdown, with the full quote table).
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/interf/vla/ (params{} holds the full records; top-level fields name their src alongside). DERIVED = arithmetic done here (shown). INFERRED = a mapping no source states. NOT FOUND = a gap. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.units: positions in metres (e east, n north, u up) relative to geometry.reference_point; frequencies GHz; angles deg unless stated; beam/LAS arcsec; pb arcmin
_meta.antenna_names: The cfg files carry only pad names (column 5); antennas are named by pad here (name = pad). Which physical antenna (ea01-ea28) sits on which pad changes with every move and is NOT FOUND.
_meta.quote_check: 94 quotes machine-checked against the saved files' extracted text (pdftotext -layout and -raw for the PDF; tag-stripped text and entity-decoded source for HTML; cfg and JSON files as is): all pass; 108 table cells of OSSR Table 3.1.1 and OSSB Table 3.3.1 re-parsed from the saved HTML: all match; the four antenna lists match their cfg files (2026-10-20).
_meta.quote_normalisation: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign (to x), tilde operator and soft hyphens normalised; table-cell separators | dropped; whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes against the text with PDF line-end hyphenation closed up, or with all whitespace removed; " ... " joins non-adjacent pieces. HTML is checked against tag-stripped text (sub/superscripts flattened, e.g. "θ PB = 42/ν GHz") and the entity-decoded source.

beam_table.conditions: uniform weighting, untapered, full 12 h synthesis, source passing near the zenith, central frequency of each band; valid for declinations -15 to +75 deg; natural weighting ~1.5x, snapshots ~1.3x (OSSR notes 2-3)

implied_factor_DERIVED.definition: k = theta_HPBW[rad] * Bmax(OSS) / lambda, lambda = c / freq_GHz

las_table.conditions: full synthesis; divide by two for a single snapshot (OSSR note 4)

pb_relation.formula: theta_PB[arcmin] = 42 / nu[GHz] (1-50 GHz); 50 / nu[GHz] at P-band

reference_point.description: origin of the NRAO station table PADS ("array center as origin"), located in the CASA XYZ frame by a least-squares fit of XYZ_cfg = C0 + Rz(theta) * c * (Lx, Ly, Lz) over all 72 pads (4 free parameters: C0 and theta; c = 0.299792458 m/ns, no scale term)

geometry.enu_conversion: DERIVED: e = -sin(lon0) dX + cos(lon0) dY; n = -sin(lat0) cos(lon0) dX - sin(lat0) sin(lon0) dY + cos(lat0) dZ; u = cos(lat0) cos(lon0) dX + cos(lat0) sin(lon0) dY + sin(lat0) dZ, with (dX, dY, dZ) = XYZ_cfg - C0 and (lat0, lon0) the WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude of C0 (a = 6378137 m, 1/f = 298.257223563). INFERRED: the cfg XYZ is an Earth-centred Earth-fixed frame compatible with WGS84 (the header states only coordsys=XYZ). Local tangent plane at C0: u includes the Earth-curvature drop of distant pads.
geometry.equatorial_from_enu: For Earth-rotation synthesis the baseline frame of PADS is X_eq = -sin(lat0) n + cos(lat0) u, Y_eq = e, Z_eq = cos(lat0) n + sin(lat0) u (X_eq in the meridian plane toward the equator, Y_eq east, Z_eq toward the north celestial pole). INFERRED frame definition (PADS does not define Lx, Ly, Lz); supported by the fit: the rotation angle about Z equals lon0 to 1e-8 deg and residuals are mm-level.

OSS label: the page heading is "VLA Observational Status Summary 2027A" while its purpose sentence names Semester 2027B (12 Nov 2027 - 21 Feb 2028, D configuration) and the 29 July 2026 deadline (quoted as printed).
notes: Positions: e, n, u in metres in the local tangent plane at the PADS origin ("array center"), DERIVED from the CASA cfg XYZ (geometry.enu_conversion). For Earth-rotation synthesis use geometry.equatorial_from_enu with lat0 = 34.0788133 deg; this reproduces the NRAO PADS Lx, Ly, Lz (x c) to 6.0 mm worst case (E72).

Cross-check CASA cfg vs NRAO PADS: all 72 pads; configuration membership marks of PADS Tables 1-4 to 1-6 equal the cfg pad lists for A, B, C and D (27 each); after the 4-parameter fit (translation + rotation about Z, no scale) the residuals are 2.0 mm rms, 6.0 mm max (E72), comparable to the 0.01 ns (3 mm) rounding of the PADS coordinates. PADS R(m) equals |L| x 0.299792458 m/ns to 5 mm (so ns = light-nanoseconds). INFERRED: the two files carry the same pad survey, so the agreement confirms the transcription and frame, not the survey itself.
Configuration scale: cfg Bmax ratios D:C:B:A = 1 : 3.285 : 10.791 : 35.515 vs OSSI 1 : 3.28 : 10.8 : 35.5 (agree to the rounding).

Beam table: theta_HPBW x Bmax(OSS) / lambda = 1.045 to 1.199 over all 40 cells (DERIVED); LAS x Bmin(OSS) / lambda = 0.58-0.65 (A), 0.55-0.61 (B), 0.83-0.85 (C), 0.82-0.84 (D) (DERIVED). C and D share the LAS row values.

Pads: D uses W1-W9, E1-E9, N1-N9; C the even pads 2-18; B pads 4, 8, 12, ..., 36; A pads 8, 16, ..., 72 on each arm. Pad N1 is 0.84 m from the PADS origin (PADS R = 0.84 m), almost entirely vertical (u = 0.843 m), i.e. the PADS origin lies 0.84 m below the N1 pad position and within 5 cm of it horizontally.
u (up) spans -53.3 to 28.1 m in A (Earth curvature and terrain); keep it for w-terms or when converting to the equatorial frame.

Elevation: hard lower limit 8 deg (OGV, OGL); recommended minima 10 deg below 15 GHz, 20 deg at S-band, 30 deg above 15 GHz; avoid > 80 deg above 15 GHz (required) and > 85 deg below; over-the-top to 125 deg possible but not default. Shadowing: at most one antenna shadowed for el > 40 deg (D), > 25 deg (C).

Bandwidth: bands[].bw_GHz is per polarization for the GO default setups. The nominal band width hi - lo (DERIVED) exceeds it at 4 (0.030 vs 0.012 GHz), P (0.30 vs 0.256), K (8.5 vs 8), Ka (13.5 vs 8) and Q (10 vs 8), and equals it at L, S, C, X and Ku.
